English: There is no god but Allah

Arabic: ان الله على كل شيء قدير
Transliteration: Inna Allaha ala kulli shay'in qadir
English: Indeed Allah is over all things competent
Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him
May Allah reward you with goodness

Arabic: لا حول ولا قوة الا بالله
Transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
English: There is no power nor might except with Allah

Transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
English: Indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we will return
May Allah's peace and blessings be upon him
May Allah be pleased with him
